chapters.title: The Noahide Laws and the Rainbow Covenant

summary: Mrs. Hidary goes through Parashat Noah, discussing how Noah builds the ark and how the text uses the names Elohim and Hashem to show the contrast between reality and potential. She explores themes of internal reflection, processing trauma, leaving the ark, and the covenant of the rainbow.
questions: Why does the text use different names of God in Parashat Noah?
What does coating the inside of the ark teach us about internal work?
How does the story of the dove leaving the ark relate to moving past trauma?
What does the rainbow symbolize in terms of God's covenant?
